name: macos-document-stack-diff-and-compact-view
title: Apple Dual-Platform (macOS & iOS/iPadOS): Document Stack, Multi-Modal Diff, Scheme B 2-Way Merge & Tactile Compact View
description: Implement Scheme B Zero-Fragmentation document adaptation and universal 5th gallery layout mode (compactList) across shared Sources/CharkleCore, macOS (Sources/CharkleApp & Sources/CharkleCanvas), and iOS/iPadOS (ios/CharkleMobile): universal AssetRichMetadata.versionStack with isPinnedPrimary anti-mis-send protection, native OOXML/PDF/Markdown/GB18030 structured extraction with local document_content_cache feeding assets_fts, Tactile 2-Column Index Grid / 1-Column Folio Strip with 3D micro-folio hover fan-out, 12-segment Diff Minimap & inline Revision Rail, JumpAnywhere Cmd+C primary file copy, Quick Look / AssetDetailView document readers, High-Risk Number/Currency/Date diff radar, Excel PK-aligned diff, scanned PDF Vision OCR + Red-Cyan / Split-Curtain visual diff, and ZIP-preserving .docx/.md/.txt 2-Way synthesis.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Implements shared Sources/CharkleCore + macOS + iOS/iPadOS in parallel, keeping Sources/CharkleCore free of SwiftUI and unguarded AppKit/Process APIs. Companion Windows parity handoff specification lives in .trellis/tasks/11-28-windows-document-stack-diff-and-compact-view-parity/ and docs/WINDOWS_DOCUMENT_SYNC_SPEC.md.
